name: picasso-react19-harness
description: Standalone React 19 install for pnpm test:react19 and STORYBOOK_REACT_19=1 (PF-2262 workstream E). Deliberately NOT a pnpm workspace member: inside the workspace its React 19 packages join hoisting/peer resolution and can win the root react-dom slot on a fresh install, breaking react-transition-group (findDOMNode) for the React 18 suite. Installed via `pnpm install --ignore-workspace` in this directory (the test:react19 script does it automatically); jest.react19.mjs and .storybook/main.js resolve react/react-dom from react19/node_modules explicitly.
